data.title: Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II Pre-Download Now Available
data.brief:
Dear Endministrator,
Pre-download for Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II is now available! The test will officially begin on 2025-11-27 at 22:00 (UTC-5).
data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

Pre-download for Arknights: Endfield Beta Test II is now available! The test will officially begin on 2025-11-27 at 22:00 (UTC-5).


1. You can visit the Beta Test II Check Access page, log in with your Gryphline account, and click [Check Now] to view your status. If you've been granted access, follow the instructions to pre-download.

>>Click Here to Go to the Check Access Page<<


2. You can also check the email you signed up with. If you've been granted access, you will receive an [email] notification with pre-download instructions.

* The email linked to the Gryphline Account you used during the survey will serve as your [notification email] and [login account] for this test.


▼// Customer Support Contact Info

If you encounter any issues during pre-download, contact our official Customer Support via:

endfield_cs@gryphline.com


Thank you again for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator!
